logp.method_description: The lipophilicity (logarithm of the partition coefficient, log P) of the complexes and photolysis products was measured using the “shake flask” method.72 Distilled water was used as an aqueous phase and 1-octanol was used as an organic phase. For the measurement, 1 ⋅ 10-4 M solutions of the complexes were prepared in H2O and then mixed with equal volume of 1-octanol. To measure the lipophilicity of the photolysis products, water solutions of the complexes were irradiated for 15 minutes using LED 445 nm, 100 mW and then mixed with equal volume of 1-octanol. The solutions were shaken for 5 min and allowed to settle for 24 h in the dark. The relative distribution of the complexes in the water and 1-octanol phases were determined spectrophotometrically. log P values were calculated using the absorbance of the complexes in 1-octanol divided by the absorbance in water at 280 nm (log P280=AOctanol/AWater).
